title: Meet the bishop
objectives: Understand that the bishop moves diagonally, any distance

steps.text: The bishop moves diagonally — any distance — as long as nothing blocks it.

steps.prompt: Move the bishop as far as it can go along one diagonal.

hints.text: Slide the bishop as far as it can go along one diagonal.
Any of the four diagonal directions works.
The bishop can slide from e4 all the way to h7.

feedback.default: The bishop only moves diagonally — not up, down, or sideways.

steps.successExplanation: That's a legal bishop move — sliding all the way along one diagonal, with nothing in the way.
